name: What size tank water heater do I need for my home?

mainEntity.name: What size tank water heater do I need for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The ideal size for your tank water heater depends on the number of people in your household and your peak hot water demand. A 40-gallon tank is often suitable for 1-2 people, a 50-gallon for 2-4 people, and a 60-80 gallon tank for 5 or more. Factors like the number of bathrooms and hot water appliances also play a role. An undersized heater may run out of hot water quickly, while an oversized one can be less energy-efficient. Our technicians can help assess your needs.
